args.name: Personal bounded residue-transfer trial
args.function: Provide a personally learnable bounded method for Moss to examine and, only if feasible, manually transfer existing residue from surface-38-moss-234 to an explicitly chosen adjacent receiver outside its footprint. The known transfer implementation is bound to Lin and surface-21-lin-113, so it is not established as usable here.
args.conditions: Moss is at (14,12.5). The completed radius-0.2 preparation left zero cover and 0.04 non-food residue in two 0.02 piles at (14.15,12.5) and (13.85,12.5). Require actual reach, receiver clearance, boundaries and source ownership checks. A potential receiver near (14.4,12.5) is only a proposal, not verified suitable.
args.inputs: Actual existing source residues only; any tool or additional material requirements remain unknown. Do not create inventory resources or reset the source.
args.costs: Method and costs may require development; specify learning costs, finite paid work, persistent progress and cancellation terms before execution.
args.effects: Conserve moved matter at the checked receiver, retain partial physical changes, and report actual remaining source residue. Do not infer root eligibility, fertility, food production or wellbeing gains from transfer alone.

candidates.function: Examine one nominated radius-0.2 footprint, then attempt at most two rounds of manual loose-cover displacement, conserving debris inside the original boundary.
candidates.costs: Fresh start: one round and 0.5 energy for feasibility. Up to two additional work rounds cost one energy each. Radius is fixed at 0.2; x/y bind the job and cannot be substituted. No tool, root, water, food or inventory material is given or consumed.
candidates.effects: Supports explicitly modeled loose forest-floor cover only. Each supported footprint begins with finite 0.04 cover mass units, with hand capacity 0.02 per work round. All displaced matter remains non-food non-harvestable residue inside the boundary. Repeated attempts reuse actual remaining cover/residues, never reset quantities. Partial changes persist; cancel/death closes only the work lock, without restoration or refund. Entire-footprint root eligibility remains false while any cover or residue remains; exhausting work does not prove suitable soil. No unattended work, regrowth suppression, planting, food, moisture/fertility improvement or reward. Study and surface changes are separate.

Successful commitment links the existing surface to one actual trial plot; completed placement cannot be cancelled into food. Existing ageing continues. No propagation, growth, harvest, fertility, free soil removal, food output, maintenance, reward or viability guarantee. Private dated evidence only; the30-round observation remains inconclusive.

candidates.function: Place owned moss, inspect the resulting arrangement or perform a real ground-supported contact/rest trial.
candidates.costs: Quote: retrieve this ability through the free control abilities query; reading these exact terms takes no world round. Begin requires inputStackId, quantity 0.1–2 in tenths, x/y and radius 0.1–0.5, two actual rounds at 1 energy each. Study costs two rounds at 0.2 energy. Inspect requires arrangementId, one round/0.2 energy. Rest-trial requires arrangementId and actual contact position, one baseline rest round, with existing mental/facility factors and cap40. Resume/cancel use exact processId. Additional placement on an owned unlocked arrangement repeats the same costs and exact footprint.
candidates.effects: First step places actual reserved moss at the site; second spreads actual tenths within the nominated radius, without mass-to-volume or coverage inference. Placed ground material is recoverable with recover(arrangementId), one round/0.5 energy for actual reachable surviving portions; this scoped pickup supports tenths that baseline whole-unit pickup cannot. Recovery removes material from the arrangement. Cancel/death preserve placed material and paid work; no refund or automatic labor. Rest measures real geometric contact and at most0.02 lateral displacement of contacted loose material inside the footprint; no inferred load strength, thickness, comfort, durability or recovery bonus. Usability remains inconclusive. Personal findings are not publicly shared. No reward, regeneration, binding, tool or stock grant.

Bare ground is distinct from the general ordinary-soil moisture regime. No deeper substrate, concealed occupant or hidden resource information. Results are not silently refreshed and sharing requires real communication.
